steps.said: Open Contacts on an empty address book
Add a contact named Ada Lovelace
Open the contact and give it an email address and where they work
The organization and the address are on the contact after typing, with nothing to save
Find the contact through the system's search
Open the contact the search found
In Mail, open the person who wrote a message in Contacts
Make the contact a favorite and find it under Favorites
Put the contact in a group, which the sidebar then offers as a place
Import a vCard whose PHOTO is written inline, and the card it makes shows the picture

file.name: Grace.vcf
file.text:
BEGIN:VCARD
VERSION:4.0
FN:Grace Hopper
ORG:US Navy
EMAIL;TYPE=work:grace@example.org
PHOTO;ENCODING=b;TYPE=JPEG:QUJD
END:VCARD

steps.said: Export the book as a vCard through the system's Export…, saved where the person says
A second card with the same mailbox is offered as the same person, and merging keeps one card and both cards' rows
The contact's Connected accounts section offers the review that binds a service account, and its share controls

offered: Share this card with the apps

steps.said: A directory entry the workspace already holds shows its account with the controls that change and forget it (needs a person the workspace's apps know; offered controls are recorded)
Importing a file of many cards shows the file being read and then how many cards were taken
